tagline: Bridge personal Todoist tasks with team Asana projects without double entry
metaTitle: Todoist + Asana Integration: Asana Assignments in Todoist
metaDescription: Sync your Asana assignments into Todoist and update Asana when you finish them. GAIA keeps personal and team task lists in step. See the setup steps.
intro:
Many professionals use Todoist for personal task management and Asana for team project work. The problem is that the two don't talk to each other: team assignments never reach the personal inbox, and personal tasks don't reflect project commitments. You end up with two separate systems to maintain.

GAIA bridges personal and team task management. When you're assigned a task in Asana, it appears in your personal inbox. When you complete that task, both lists update. Your personal productivity system and your team's project management stay synchronized without double entry.

useCases.title: Asana assignments synced to Todoist
useCases.description: When you're assigned a task, GAIA automatically adds it to your Todoist inbox so all your work, individual and team, appears in one task manager.

useCases.title: Completion in Todoist updates the project board
useCases.description: When you complete a task that came from a team project, GAIA marks it complete in Asana automatically so your team's project board stays accurate without extra effort.

useCases.title: Personal task context for project managers
useCases.description: Personal tasks related to team projects can be linked so project managers see the full picture of work being done, both the tracked project tasks and the personal prep work.

useCases.title: Due date synchronization
useCases.description: When a task's due date changes in the project, GAIA updates the corresponding personal task's due date automatically so your priority list always reflects the latest project schedule.

useCases.title: Daily personal briefing from Asana
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA creates a daily overview that includes tasks due today from the team project alongside your personal tasks, giving you a complete view of the day's commitments.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Todoist account and Asana workspace. Configure which projects should sync their tasks.
Choose whether all assignments sync or only assignments from specific projects. Configure which personal project receives the synced tasks.

howItWorks.step: One task list for all your work
howItWorks.description: GAIA maintains synchronization between both systems. You manage your work from one list while the team's board stays updated automatically.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create duplicates if a task is in both Todoist and Asana?
faqs.answer: GAIA tracks which personal tasks originated from the team project and avoids creating duplicates. Updates flow between the linked tasks rather than creating new entries each time.

faqs.question: Can I use labels to organize synced tasks alongside personal tasks?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can apply labels based on the project the task came from, making it easy to filter your view to show only team work or only personal tasks.

faqs.question: Does this work with shared projects as well as personal ones?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can sync team tasks to shared projects so your whole team can manage that work from the shared projects if preferred.
